Bea: spotted a mismatch on launch KPIs — dashboard shows leads up 12% but email invites down 22%.
Calvin: which cohort? organic or paid?
Bea: quick split shows paid uplift only. link: https://dash.redwood/launch/cohort-quick
Nora: possible tagging rename from campaign->cmp in paid redirect. saw a recent redirect patch yesterday.
Calvin: SQL quick check:

```
SELECT campaign, count(*) leads, sum(email_invite::int) invites
FROM events.signups
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-28' AND ts < '2026-03-29'
GROUP BY 1;
```

Nora: results: paid: leads 6,200 invites 48 (0.77%); organic: leads 3,400 invites 110 (3.2%). paid rows show campaign column null but cmp contains 'q2-paid'.
Bea: ok action: (1) map cmp->campaign in ingestion (calvin) (2) backfill invites metric for last 48h (nora) (3) kube alert for future null campaign (bea) 
Calvin: opening PR for mapping and will include test. target deploy in next deploy window.
Nora: queuing backfill job BF-9002. will post when complete.
kpi-bot: Weekly KPI note: new leads +9%; email invites -3%; ingestion alias mapping added to backlog ticket MK-5333.
Bea: thanks — will add to KPI review tomorrow and mark as resolved if backfill clears. :thumbsup:
